Connect Gmail or Outlook and SparkReceipt automatically finds and imports email receipts as they arrive. No more digging through your inbox at month end or before tax season. You stay in control: review, approve, and exclude senders any time.

EMAIL RECEIPT FORWARDING

Prefer to file receipts manually? Forward eReceipts to your personal SparkReceipt address and the AI files them for you. Useful for shared inboxes or accounts you do not want to connect.

AI RECEIPT SCANNING (OCR)

The OCR receipt scanner reads paper receipts, PDF invoices, and forwarded email receipts in any language and currency. Smart categorization is based on the products on the receipt, not just the merchant name, so business expenses end up in the right account.

INCOME, EXPENSES, AND PROFIT/LOSS TRACKING

Invite your accountant directly into SparkReceipt or share a secure link. Stop emailing receipts as attachments. Set time limits to auto-hide shared receipts after tax season.

TEAM COLLABORATION

Invite teammates and keep everyone's receipts and expenses organized in one secure place. Sort by category, tag, or user, and approve expense reports together.

CLOUD STORAGE THAT WORKS EVERYWHERE

Documents are encrypted and backed up in the cloud. Access them from iPhone, iPad, or any browser via the SparkReceipt web app at no extra cost.

POWERFUL SEARCH

Find any receipt by name, merchant, amount, tag, category, or even text inside the image. OCR text is fully searchable.

KEY FEATURES

- Email inbox auto-scanning for Gmail, Outlook and IMAP

- Smart categorization based on products on the receipt

Freelancers tracking project expenses. Self-employed consultants managing multiple income streams. Real estate investors tracking property costs. Small business owners preparing for tax season. Accountants who want their clients to send tidy, categorized receipts instead of shoeboxes.

Stop the receipt chaos. Start tracking business expenses like a pro.
